(1) PA Report 1/2026 (Planting Advisory Report, Planting Advisor Mr. Boey Chee Weng, visit 13 May 2026, reviewing January to December 2025). (2) Agronomy Report 1/2026 (Agronomist En. Period note: PA financial and crop figures cover Jan-Dec 2025; Agro yield figures cover full year 2025 and Jan-Mar 2026. Money in RM.

AREA (PA 1/2026 section 2, no change in the area statement). Mature 464.0 ha (95.67%), total planted 464.0 ha, no immature. Unplanted (jungle) 8.00 ha (1.65%), labour quarters 13.0 ha (2.68%), total 484.99 ha. All planting material Yangambi DXP. Fields (ha): P98 1998 74; P02 2002 74; P11A 2011 47; P11B 2011 64; P12A 2012 44; P12B 2012 64; P13A 2013 51; P13B 2013 46. PA 2.2: no replanting plans for this estate. Agro (section 2, Tables 1-3): block system unchanged and suitable for leaf sampling. About 68% of area is prime-age palms; 16% aged 20-25 years and 16% over 26 years. Tentative replanting: P98 (74 ha) in 2028, P02 (74 ha) in 2029; fertiliser programme for P98 to cease in 2027. Agro text says P98 is about 1% of estate area, but its Table 2 shows 15.95% for each of P98 and P02 (74 of 464 ha). No recent palm census (Agro 2.5); density 136-140 palms/ha in P98, P02, P11, P12 and 119-121 palms/ha in P13 sub-blocks. Palms per field (Agro Table 3): P98K 10,064 (136/ha); P02L 10,064 (136); P11A 6,392 (136); P11B 8,960 (140); P12A 5,984 (136); P12B 8,704 (136); P13A 6,171 (121); P13B 5,474 (119).

LABOUR (PA 1/2026 section 3, as of Dec 2025). Total workers 38 against 41 required (-3). Harvesters 23 against 23 required (ratio 1:20 ha, adequate). Manuring workers 3 of 3. Spraying workers 4 of 4. Spraying mandore 3 of 3. Manuring mandore 1 of 1. Drivers 2 of 2. Loaders 0 of 2 (short 2). Security guards 2 of 3 (short 1). Worker to planted ha ratio 1:12 ha, adequate. The Group MD asked that the contractor be guided on work arrangements, worker welfare and salary payment, and that estate management reduce harvester turnover. PA 12.1: harvesters should earn high wages through high productivity and work 9 hours a day; PA 7.7 says harvesters work only 5 to 6.5 hours. Agro 5.2: first-quarter 2026 intervals in old plantings were hurt by weather and lower harvester output during public holidays; Agro 6.4 mentions harvester absenteeism and weather disruptions.

GENERAL CHARGES (PA section 5, Jan-Dec 2025). Actual RM724,081.03 against budget RM422,931.00, i.e. RM1,560.52/ha against RM911.49/ha. Per ha actual vs budget: weeding 203.29 vs 201.14; manuring 1,561.48 vs 1,491.59 (RM724,525 vs RM692,097); pest and disease 9.70 vs 69.85 (RM4,500 vs RM32,412); census and thinning 4.09 vs 11.94; drains 7.70 vs no budget (RM3,575); roads and bridges 94.50 vs 140.54; boundary, survey, fences 0.44 vs 30.71; pruning 124.22 vs 123.91. WEEDING (PA, 2025). Circle spraying 1,244 ha (2.7 rounds, 100% of budget; 2 rounds for old plantings, 3 for younger mature). Circles generally clean except P02 (partly clean, some due for spraying). P11 and P12: Mix B 2250 g Jan, kieserite 750 g Mar, Mix B 2250 g Apr, rock phosphate 1500 g Jun, Mix B 2250 g Aug. PEST AND DISEASE.
